_maintained_by: hand, verified by spec/check_vectors.py. No tool generates this file; an earlier version claimed spec/check_vectors.py --emit, which does not exist.
_tolerance: 6 significant digits, relative, unless a field declares otherwise
_storage: Every float vector is stored at 7 significant digits (%.6e) and asserted at 6. Storing more precision than is asserted leaves headroom. An earlier version stored some entries in %.6f, which gives only 5 significant digits for values below 1, under this same 6-digit declaration; see CORRECTION 4.

G_of_T._note: sig = significant digits the spec states this value to

branch_continuity.note: The spec text states 1e-11. The true Taylor truncation term at x=1e-3 is x^3/60 = 1.67e-11, so a literal test at 1e-11 fails. See CORRECTION 2.
